sentences.translation: # Exchange of e-mails with business partners
I am Taro Yamada of Yamada Corporation.
I'm always very much in your care.
We will be in touch with you on the delivery date scheduled for June 20th.
We have decided to exhibit at the exhibition from June 16th, so if we can prepare, can we make the delivery date forward on June 15th?
I'm very surprised to say that I cannot help but I hope you will consider it.
This is Kenji Suzuki of Suzuki Manufacturing.
Thank you for contacting us the other day.
I would like to express my sincere gratitude for your special favor.
We confirmed the delivery date in advance.
We are very sorry, but June 15th is a difficult situation to respond to due to the manufacturing schedule.
We expect that we can respond to this request with internal adjustments at the moment.
We will contact you again this week as soon as we have final confirmation.
I am very sorry for the inconvenience, but I would like to continue to thank you.
